grammar.title: Probably, roughly with 大概
grammar.explanation: 大概 (dàgài) means "probably, roughly, approximately" — used when giving an estimate rather than an exact number or fact. It usually comes before a number, time, or guess about a situation.

sentences.zh: 他不得不接受这个结果。
sentences.en: He had no choice but to accept this result.

sentences.zh: 时间不够，我不得不快点走了。
sentences.pinyin: Shíjiān bù gòu, wǒ bùdébù kuài diǎn zǒu le.
sentences.en: There wasn't enough time, so I had to hurry off.
He's probably around thirty years old.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dàgài shì zhēn de.

sentences.zh: 我们大概需要两个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dàgài xūyào liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.en: We probably need about two hours.
